title: Site pages
lead: The words of the story pages, the parish history and the council. The pages’ structure and animations stay in code: here you only change the texts and the people.
texts_help: Until a text is published, the site keeps its current text. A text that contains a fact (a date, a name, a figure) must be validated first.
publish_error: Can’t publish: the French text is empty.
publish_error_ms: Can’t publish: it needs a date and a title.
needs_publisher: Someone allowed to publish must publish this text for it to appear on the site.
history_help: The milestones of “Climbing the hill”, oldest to newest. Each published milestone appears on the hill; dates and facts must be validated before publishing.
ms_empty_p: Until a milestone is published, the page keeps its current text.
ms_validate: Only publish this milestone once the date and the story are validated by the content partner.
ms_delete_p: It will disappear from the hill.
council_help: A name, a photo and a term show on the site only with the person’s consent, which you record here. Without consent only the role appears.
consent_label: This person agrees that their name (and photo) are public on the site
consent_help: We record who noted this consent and when. Untick it to withdraw: the name disappears from the site.
council_empty_p: Until a name is public, the page explains how the parish is led and shows the roles without names.
member_delete_p: They will no longer appear on the page.

site.invite_t: What if the next chapter carried your name?
site.invite_p: Every stone on this hill was laid by someone who came one day, knowing nothing in advance. You are not just another visitor: you are expected, and your place is already kept.
site.invite_kicker: The next part is written with you
site.way1_p: Sit down, listen, sing if you feel like it.
site.way2_p: Choir, youth, women… find where to settle in.
site.way3_p: Create your space and follow the life of the parish.
